project: Super Mario Galaxy native PC build
approach: Static recompilation of the disc's own code on the player's PC; bring your own disc, no game files distributed.
notes: Shows the title screen ("Press both A and B") and the file select. About 59 fps on both machines. Tested on Windows 11 (RTX 3070 Ti) and on a Linux mini PC (Ryzen 3 4350GE, Vega 6) with scripted inputs; nothing here says the game is playable to the end. Built with AI assistance (Claude).
